summary: Defines the /.well-known/ path prefix, a reserved place on a site where standard files and metadata can be found at predictable locations. It also set up a registry for names under that prefix. It is no longer current, because it was replaced by RFC 8615.

eli5.summary: Every house keeps its fire plan in the same spot by the front door, so anyone who needs it knows exactly where to look.

questions: where to put site metadata files
